selected_news.source_headline: ‘A despicable betrayal’: Democrats incensed by Haley Stevens’s endorsement of Mike Rogers
selected_news.article_text: Stevens’s decision sparked fierce backlash from members of the party, while Donald Trump praised the sudden switch Democrat Haley Stevens’s shocking last-minute endorsement of Mike Rogers, the Michigan Republican Senate candidate, in the run-up to Tuesday’s midterm elections has sparked fierce backlash from members of her party Stevens, who narrowly lost in the Democratic primary for Senate to Abdul El-Sayed, announced her support for Rogers after a feud with the El-Sayed campaign over an outside group’s advertisement, which blamed the high cost of living on US support for Israel Stevens had said she would appear at a campaign event if he denounced the advertisement. El-Sayed’s campaign disinvited her Following the extraordinary public rupture on Sunday, El-Sayed’s campaign said it raised more than $2.4m, a fundraising record in the final days of a race that could determine control of the US senate. The Democrat’s campaign said more than 26,000 people contributed for the first time on Sunday New York Democrat Chuck Schumer, the Senate minority leader, described Stevens’ endorsement of Rogers as “a despicable betrayal” “Senate Democrats are united in our support for Abdul El-Sayed, because we know he will fight for the economic interests of working families in Michigan, unlike Mike Rogers, who is a tool of Donald Trump and billionaire donors,” Schumer posted on social media Nancy Pelosi, the Democratic former House speaker, posted that Stevens had “chosen to dangerously betray Michigan families’ healthcare, freedoms and future with her horrific endorsement” The New York mayor, Zohran Mamdani, said that “working class people’s lives are on the ballot on Tuesday” “Haley Stevens just betrayed them by endorsing the very Republican she said she wanted to run against,” Mamdani posted Stevens refused to clearly explain what led to her endorsement of Rogers in an interview with Anderson Cooper on CNN Sunday evening. “I’m just casting my one vote this way,” Stevens said, while insisting she still wanted Democrats to win the majority on election day “I am not trying to upset anyone,” she added. “I’m just being honest with my constituents and what I’m hearing from people, and in fact, I’ve been hearing from a ton of Dems, Anderson, who said: ‘Thank you, this is how we felt; we haven’t liked this campaign; it’s painful.’” Cooper pressed Stevens, questioning whether being disinvited from El-Sayed’s campaign event triggered her endorsement of Rogers. At one point, Stevens refused to answer the question, allowing several seconds of silence to air Stevens has continued to defend her decision as she faces accusations of betrayal from Democrats, including calls for her expulsion from the House caucus. Several members of her congressional staff resigned in protest. In an interview on Monday, she compared herself with Pennsylvania Senator John Fetterman, a one-time progressive who now frequently breaks with his party, especially over supporting Israel “You see a Democrat from Pennsylvania, you know, his name’s a lightning rod in the party. His name’s Fetterman,” she told conservative commentator Scott Jennings. “They say the same thing about him.” Curtis Hertel, the chair the Michigan Democratic party, said in a post that Stevens was not a member of the party “nor will she be in the future” A Detroit journalist, Sam Robinson, shared a video in which Hertel was asked why he thought Stevens made the endorsement “Obviously there are sour grapes from the election, but there is no reasonable explanation for this. I have known Haley Stevens for a long time, and I know what she has fought for her in her career, and this is the antithesis of all of that,” Hertel said Debbie Dingell, a veteran Michigan House Democrat, dismissed Stevens’s endorsement as a distraction from voters’ concerns about the cost of living “That’s what they’re talking about, not Congresswoman Stevens’ continued efforts to get attention,” she said in a statement On MS Now on Sunday, El-Sayed encouraged undecided Michigan voters to stand with him to protect democracy in the United States. “The divide in our politics isn’t left versus right; the divide in our politics is the people who are locked out versus the people who are locking them out,” El-Sayed said Speaking to Fox News on Monday, Rogers praised Stevens for her endorsement. “I know Democrats are thumping their chest and saying she has done something other than courageous,” he said. “It was nothing but courageous.” Charlotte Clymer, a blogger and activist who supports Democrats, told the Guardian she had considered Stevens a friend for several years, and said the congresswoman’s decision to back Rogers “is like endorsing Donald Trump” “This is like living through a bad dream. It really is,” Clymer said. “If you had told me there’d be a sitting Democratic member of Congress who would switch like this, Haley would not have come to mind.” She called Stevens a lawmaker of “strident integrity” who has stood up for LGBTQ+ rights, unions and abortion access. As tensions rose with the El-Sayed campaign Clymer said that on on Saturday she texted Stevens, who replied with messages assuring her she still supported the Democratic nominee. Clymer said she texted again after Stevens released a video endorsing Rogers on Sunday, but has not heard back “It really is bizarre. It feels like there [is] a body snatcher moment. Someone has kidnapped Haley Stevens and replaced her with a completely different person,” Clymer said Meanwhile, Trump praised Stevens’s endorsement of Rogers on his platform Truth Social and described her as a “highly respected Democrat”. He again cheered Stevens during a campaign rally on Sunday in Dubuque, Iowa, and encouraged her to switch parties “I’d love her to join the Republican party, actually, I think that could happen maybe. But she showed great and almost unprecedented loyalty to the great people of Michigan,” Trump said When asked about Trump praising her, Stevens told CNN: “Well, I impeached him twice,” before criticizing Republicans for being “really focused on just letting Trump be the dictator”

selected_news.title: Florida'da Learjet 60 kazası: 9 ölü, NTSB soruşturması
selected_news.summary: The National Transportation Safety Board also believes weather could have been a factor in the crash, but warns it is too early to determine the cause.
selected_news.source_headline: Plane may have broken apart ahead of deadly Florida jet crash, say investigators
selected_news.article_text: The US National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) says it will investigate whether parts of a jet that crashed in Florida broke off before it nose-dived and exploded, killing all nine people on board The Learjet 60, which was travelling from Austin, Texas to the Bahamas on Sunday, crashed on a street nine miles (14 km) from President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort A tech entrepreneur and his young family, as well as the 20-year-old copilot, were among those who died The NTSB said on Monday that it would also investigate to what extent ice and turbulence may have been contributing factors It confirmed that, after the jet took off from Austin, the crew transmitted to air traffic control that they were encountering ice and moderate turbulence "We are picking up precipitation, requesting to climb to 37,000 feet if able," the crew said NTSB member Tom Chapman said that less than 30 seconds later, the plane began to descend and the crew issued a mayday call The transmission then became "unintelligible", he said, adding that: "Sadly, all aboard were lost." The NTSB said that ice and turbulence were factors in the crash but that determining its probable cause will be a "lengthy investigatory process" Thunderstorms had been reported in the area at the time Officials are also trying to find out whether a cockpit voice recorder was on board at the time of the crash and if it can be recovered As part of the investigation, the NTSB is working with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), representatives from Learjet as well as meteorologists and air traffic control experts Recovering the wreckage from the crater on the roadway will be a "daunting challenge", said Timothy Monville, an air safety investigator with the safety board Flight analysis indicates the jet was plummeting hundreds of feet per second before crashing In air traffic control audio, a crew member can be heard declaring an emergency, shouting "we are in an overspeed condition descending 20,000ft per minute", before saying, "we are going to crash into the ground" About 35 seconds after the initial mayday announcement, the last remark from the cockpit appears to be "we're out of time" The seven people killed who were travelling as passengers were identified in a joint statement from their families as tech entrepreneur Adam Robinson, his wife Helen Sharp, and their two children - Emma and Charlie - as well as Rachael Reed, Charmi Fehr and Anita Maria Cetina The pilot was named in media reports as Jeffery Gregory, while Nathalia Filgueiras, who earned her pilot's licence when she was 17, was reported to be the copilot As well as those killed, one man on the ground sustained a leg injury when the plane nosedived onto the street The Palm Beach County Sheriff's Office said the crash happened on Military Trail, a six-lane road lined with businesses and restaurants Images from the crash scene show a large fiery crater in the middle of a residential suburban street The debris was scattered across sports fields, businesses and homes in the area, officials told a news conference on Monday, possible evidence that the plane broke up before it hit the ground Unverified footage posted on social media shows what appears to be a dash-camera recording of the moment of the crash Trump was at Mar-a-Lago on Sunday morning, and departed from an airport nearby on Air Force One about an hour before the crash

selected_news.quality_narration: NTSB, Florida'da Military Trail üzerindeki Learjet 60 çarpışmasında 9 kişinin hayatını kaybettiğini doğruladı. Araştırmacılar, uçağın inişten kısa bir süre sonra buz ve orta şiddette türbülansla karşılaştığını ve bu koşulların kazaya etkisini inceleyeceklerini belirtti. İlk mayday sinyali verildikten yaklaşık 30 saniye içinde uçak, 20.000 ft/dakika hızla alçalırken "zamanımız kalmadı" diyerek çöküşe yol açtı.
